title: Zuljanah bal minal maidan
body:
Zuljanah bal minal maidan
<<MINI>>
Zuljanah akbal minal maydan, khali wawayla haye wa hussaina Ay wa gharib.
Haye wa hussaina.
Ay wa shaheed.
Haye wa hussaina.
Ay wa mazloom.
Haye wa hussaina.
Zuljanah akbal
minal maydan khali wawayla haye wa hussaina.
<<DIVIDER>>
(Shor-e huwa lo, khali aya) x2 Chor-e ke zainab-e ka ma jaya. Bage kati hai khun me nahaya. Zainab-e ne dukhra ye sunaya.
